card.name: Web addresses in educational resource lists
card.fires_on: Mostly the word Web, a space, or http in 'Web site: http://' lines inside lists of kids' and teaching resources, plus scattered credit lines and linking words in educational text.

modes.label: Web site listings
modes.description: The words Web, site or http, or the space before a ZIP code, in contact blocks for children's magazines and school sites.
modes.example: 10 Web site: http://www.kidsdiscover.com SAS Campus Drive Cary, NC 27513 <<Web>> site: http://www.ncsu.edu

modes.label: Credit and author lines
modes.description: A space or comma after a person's name or affiliation in education-related credits or reviewer lines.
modes.example: Reviewed by: Larissa Hirsch, MD<< >>Date reviewed: March 201

modes.label: Linking words in teaching text
modes.description: A preposition or verb in school or science lesson sentences.
modes.example: All students need to be reminded<< about>> how to go to school.

card.writes: It suppresses teaching and education words, so it lowers the chance the next word is about teaching or children.
card.plain: It marks web-address and credit lines in kids' education resource lists, and holds back teaching words there.
